clips.title: 安迪·伯纳姆誓言将财政权力从伦敦下放

subtitles.en: Kirsta Amur was arguably at his best on the global stage.
subtitles.zh: 柯丝蒂·阿穆尔在全球舞台上可谓处于巅峰状态。

subtitles.en: The man who's odd on to replace him is keeping his focus much more local.
subtitles.zh: 即将接替他的人则更关注本地事务。

subtitles.en: In his first speech since returning to Westminster, Andy Burnham took to a podium in Manchester where he was until recently mayor to set out his vision for the country and the economy.
subtitles.zh: 安迪·伯纳姆重返威斯敏斯特后的首次演讲中，在曼彻斯特的讲台上阐述了他对国家和经济的愿景。

subtitles.en: He outlined plans to devolve fiscal powers to the regions.
subtitles.zh: 他概述了将财政权力下放给各地区的计划。

subtitles.en: He said that this will be a radical devolution agenda, but promised to stick to the UK's fiscal rules and said that growth won't come from leaving everything to the markets.
subtitles.zh: 他表示这将是一项激进的分权议程，但承诺遵守英国财政规则，并称增长不会来自放任市场。

subtitles.en: He pledged the biggest council house building programme in the post-war period.
subtitles.zh: 他承诺实施战后最大规模的市政住房建设计划。

subtitles.en: He said that he was going to reform business rates to support pubs and high street businesses.
subtitles.zh: 他表示将改革商业税率以支持酒吧和商业街企业。

subtitles.en: He pledged to do his best to give people breathing space as soon as he possibly can, but it was all quite vibes, heavy and details light.
subtitles.zh: 他承诺尽快为民众提供喘息空间，但整体上理念多、细节少。

subtitles.en: Britain's have heard before that there'll be more homes built, that Britain will be levelled up, that the cost of living will be eased,
subtitles.zh: 英国人之前就听过要建更多住房、实现地区平衡、缓解生活成本压力。

subtitles.en: how Burnham will implement his vision of Manchesterism with yet to find out.
subtitles.zh: 伯纳姆如何实施他的“曼彻斯特主义”愿景仍有待观察。

subtitles.en: It was built as his first major economic speech, and yet he said that we'd have to wait several weeks for the conclusion of the Labour leadership contest, which is effectively now a one-horse race,
subtitles.zh: 这场演讲本应是他的首个重要经济讲话，但他却表示，要等几周后工党领袖竞选结果出炉——实际上已是独角戏——才能知道谁将担任财政大臣。

subtitles.en: to find out who his chancellor is going to be. Notably, Burnham said that it was all consistent with Labour's 2024 manifesto,
subtitles.zh: 值得注意的是，伯纳姆称这与工党2024年宣言一致，这至少回答了是否即将举行大选的问题。

subtitles.en: so that at least perhaps answers the question of whether a general election is round the corner sometime soon.
subtitles.zh: 所以，这至少可能回答了是否很快会举行大选的问题。
